intelligence.human_view: He said: the calendar is much better, actually — but the "i" — he can't see it. It looks like an object, but it's too bright, with the eye in the middle, like you can't see it. So make the eye black in the middle, so you can see it — that may work. Right now it's too bright, you can't see what it is. A jewel that reads as a white blob is not a jewel; the mark that tells you "click here for the day's info" has to be readable at a glance, and readability is contrast — a black centre, a white "i" on it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a shiny pearl button with a little "i" on it — but the "i" is white on white, so you can't see it at all! Silly, right? So we paint the middle black, like the night sky, and now the little white "i" pops right out — you can see it! That's all it takes: a dark middle so the light letter can shine.
